title: UI风格#149 - Medieval Manuscript (中世纪手稿)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript style When color palette Then features parchment cream, ink black, illuminated gold, burgundy red
Given Medieval Manuscript style When typography Then uses gothic fonts: Uncial Antiqua, Cinzel, or IM Fell English
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Cinzel (headers 2.2rem 600 weight), Cormorant Garamond (body 0.95rem 400-600 weight) - medieval serif fonts

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript style When layout Then illuminated borders, margin illustrations, rubrication, scriptorium
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: illuminated gold inner border, parchment texture overlay, medieval divider with ❧ symbol, gothic layout aesthetic

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript style When UI elements Then parchment texture, gold leaf, ink bleed, vellum edges
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: parchment texture background, gold accent borders, burgundy red highlights, medieval decorative symbols (❧☙✧❦)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript UI When functional Then includes scribe chat, monk agents, scroll stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Medieval Manuscript UI When copy Then uses monastic: 'Script', 'Illuminated', 'Scribe', 'Vellum'
